correctness.summary: On the interior incidence domain, Hausdorff-convergent pairs K and K-x have a common limiting interior ball, which yields Hausdorff continuity of K∩(K-x) by a contraction-plus-support-function argument. Mixed-volume continuity then gives joint continuity of the special Bézout defect. Langharst--Wang's exact special-test characterization supplies a strict violating displacement for every non-simplex; continuity makes the witness set open, density supplies a rational witness, and joint continuity makes that same rational witness persist with positive margin under small Hausdorff perturbations. The unit-square calculation independently verifies the defect sign.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The current Langharst--Wang v1 states the special test for every admissible displacement but no countable dense test bank, open positive-measure strict-witness set, or Hausdorff-stable rational witness was located. Searches over the motivating paper, earlier Bézout mixed-volume literature, and the current SCOPE archive using rational/countable/dense/robust witness formulations found no matching statement. The continuity ingredients themselves are standard; the claimed contribution is the certification and robustness consequence. Because the motivating preprint is extremely recent and the deduction is short, later revisions or unindexed parallel observations remain a residual risk.

value.summary: The result replaces an uncountable universal family of structured Bézout tests by one fixed countable dense family and proves that non-simplex failure is robust rather than exceptional: a single rational displacement certifies an entire Hausdorff neighborhood with positive violation margin. This also yields positive-probability random detection for each fixed non-simplex, while clearly isolating the missing quantitative problem of uniform witness size or margin.

limitations: The result relies on the Langharst--Wang simplex characterization and is not a new proof of that theorem.
No dimension-only lower bound is given for witness-set measure, violation margin, sampling probability, or Hausdorff stability radius.
The continuity statement is restricted to interior difference-body shifts; no boundary extension is claimed.
The motivating preprint is very recent, so later revisions or unindexed parallel observations may overlap.
Independent audit has not been performed.
